meta.title: Top-20 open-weights models by Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index - architecture survey for a KV-cache translator
meta.ranking_method: AA leaderboard page payload (Next.js RSC models array), isOpenWeights=true and deprecated=false; reasoning-effort variants of the same weights collapsed to their best score. Index version: v4.3 (AutomationBench-AA added, tau3-Banking removed, Terminal-Bench 4.0). Latest release date in the AA payload: 2026-09-30.
meta.kv_convention: bf16 (2 bytes). GQA: n_kv x (d_k + d_v) x 2B per KV-bearing layer. MLA: (kv_lora_rank + qk_rope_head_dim) x 2B per layer. SWA layers are bounded (fixed_swa_bytes_bf16) and excluded from per-token growth. Indexer keys (DSA/MSA/QSA/CSA) reported separately. Recurrent states (GDN/KDA) reported as fixed per-sequence bytes; *_fp32_state uses fp32 for the matrix state (common in kernels; Qwen configs set mamba_ssm_dtype=float32).

translator_family_legend.F1_full_gqa: per-token GQA K/V in every layer with RoPE
translator_family_legend.F3_mla_latent: MLA-style per-token latent (kv_lora_rank + rope dims) shared by heads
translator_family_legend.F4_compressed_latent: DeepSeek V4 family: 128-token window + learned pooled (compressed) latent entries, no per-token global KV
translator_family_legend.F5_linear_hybrid: recurrent/linear-attention layers (Gated DeltaNet or KDA) with fixed state + per-token cache in ~1/4 of layers
translator_family_legend.nope: cached keys carry no rotary phase (NoPE / learned relative bias)
